cohort: The study included 68 nulliparous pregnant women aged 20-38 with no comorbidities, admitted to Basaksehir Cam and Sakura City Hospital, divided into a late-term pregnancy group (>=41 weeks) and a control group (37-38 weeks).
finding: Lower maternal FT4 values were significantly associated with fetal distress and a statistically significant negative linear relationship was found between FT4 values and newborn weights, meaning lower FT4 was associated with higher newborn weights.
mod_finding: No statistically significant difference was found between TSH/FT4 values and birth types.
gest_age: Participants included those at 37-38 weeks (control group) and >=41 weeks (late-term pregnancy group).
